description: This file contains Odoo (OpenERP) module code defining models and methods for handling iCalendar (ICS) data, including processing, reading, and writing ICS calendar events, as well as extending the crm.case model with calendar-related fields and logic.

classes.name: document_directory_ics_fields
classes.description: Model representing mapping between OpenERP fields and ICS tags.

classes.name: document_directory_content
classes.description: Model extension for handling ICS content, including processing ICS data for read/write operations.

classes.name: crm_case
classes.description: Extension of crm.case model with calendar code and deadline, including logic for copying and duration calculation.

methods.name: process_write_ics
methods.description: Parses ICS data and updates or creates corresponding records in the database.

methods.name: process_read_ics
methods.description: Generates ICS calendar data from database records.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a crm.case record with a new unique calendar code.

methods.name: on_change_duration
methods.description: Calculates and updates the deadline date based on start date and duration, preventing negative durations.
